newsitem.title: USA: Biopsys gets FDA premarket nod for system.
newsitem.headline: Biopsys gets FDA premarket nod for system.

text.p: Biopsys Medical Inc said Wednesday it had received 510(k) premarket notification clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the Mammotome Biopsy diagnostic-tissue-sampling system.

The approval comes after the FDA requested the company to clarify the labeling and intended purposes of the device. The regulatory agency had been concerned that it was being used for the excision of tissue.

"We are pleased to have resolved this matter expeditiously and without any material impact on the company's operations," Biopsys President and Chief Executive Steven Gex said in a statement accompanying the announcment.

The 510(k) notification was submitted February 12 "to fulfill the FDA's requests and desire to establish consistent indications and promotional materials for all breast biopsy devices," the company said.
The FDA clearance allows Biopsys to market the Mammotome Biopsy System specifically for breast biopsy for diagnostic purposes, the company said.
Biopsys makes products for the diagnosis and management of breast cancer.
